name: Venomancer: Locust Swarm is in the Fortitude tab, not Stalking (#11934)
contract: Issue #11934. Locust Swarm (560247) is the Fortitude talent CharacterAdvancement 6119 in Tab 78, but
SkillLineAbility row 22250 filed it under SkillLine 104 (Stalking), so the Fortitude spellbook tab did not list it.
Every other active Fortitude talent, such as Molt (805102, row 89239), is in SkillLine 105. Row 22250 now carries
SkillLine 105 on the server and in the client patch streamed after the spell is learned.
